name: BookAppointment
description: Book an appointment at a dentist for a given time and date. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

name: FindProvider
description: Find a dentist by location and optionally by services offered. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

name: set_appointment_reminder
description: This tool is used to create a reminder for a user-specified appointment. It requires details such as the appointment name, date, time, and optionally, the address and reminder time.

required_parameters.name: appointment_name
required_parameters.description: A descriptive name of the appointment for which a reminder is being set.

required_parameters.name: appointment_date
required_parameters.description: The date of the appointment in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

required_parameters.name: appointment_time
required_parameters.description: The time of the appointment for which a reminder is being set. Should be provided in a standard time format such as HH:MM.

required_parameters.name: appointment_address
required_parameters.description: The address of the appointment location, if applicable.

required_parameters.name: reminder_time
required_parameters.description: The time at which the reminder should trigger. Should be provided in a relative format such as '2 hours before' or an exact time format such as HH:MM.

optional_parameters.name: appointment_information
optional_parameters.description: Provides detailed summary or specific information about the appointment. This could include purpose, participants, location, or any other important details relevant to the appointment.

name: get_user_appointments
description: This tool is designed to retrieve a list of scheduled appointments for the user. It can filter appointments by various criteria such as date, name, and type of appointment.

optional_parameters.name: date
optional_parameters.description: The specific date for which the user wants to retrieve appointments. It should follow the YYYY-MM-DD format.

optional_parameters.name: name
optional_parameters.description: The name or description of the appointment to help narrow down the search.

optional_parameters.name: type
optional_parameters.description: The type of appointment, such as 'dentist', 'doctor', 'work meeting', etc., to filter the appointments list.

optional_parameters.name: time_range
optional_parameters.description: A time range within the specified date to retrieve appointments for, such as 'morning' or 'afternoon'.

result_parameters.name: appointment_address
result_parameters.description: The location or address of the appointment.

name: delete_appointment
description: This tool is used to delete a specific appointment from a user's schedule based on provided identifiers such as appointment ID or date and time.

optional_parameters.name: appointment_name
optional_parameters.description: A descriptive name of the appointment for which a reminder is being set.

optional_parameters.name: appointment_date
optional_parameters.description: The date of the appointment in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

optional_parameters.name: appointment_time
optional_parameters.description: The time of the appointment for which a reminder is being set. Should be provided in a standard time format such as HH:MM.

result_parameters.name: deletion_status
result_parameters.description: Status of the deletion operation, indicating success or failure.

name: change_appointment
description: This tool is used to modify the details of an existing appointment. It requires the appointment ID along with the new information to be updated.

optional_parameters.name: appointment_name
optional_parameters.description: A descriptive name of the appointment for which a reminder is being set.

optional_parameters.name: appointment_date
optional_parameters.description: The date of the appointment in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

optional_parameters.name: appointment_time
optional_parameters.description: The time of the appointment for which a reminder is being set. Should be provided in a standard time format such as HH:MM.

optional_parameters.name: new_appointment_name
optional_parameters.description: A descriptive name of the appointment for which a reminder is being set.

optional_parameters.name: new_appointment_date
optional_parameters.description: The new date for the appointment, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

optional_parameters.name: new_appointment_time
optional_parameters.description: The new time for the appointment, provided in a standard time format such as HH:MM.

optional_parameters.name: new_appointment_location
optional_parameters.description: Optional. The new location or address for the appointment if it has changed.

optional_parameters.name: new_appointment_information
optional_parameters.description: Optional. A new description for the appointment if additional details need to be specified.

result_parameters.name: update_status
result_parameters.description: Indicates whether the appointment was successfully updated or not.

name: LookupSong
description: Search for a song. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

name: PlaySong
description: Play the selected song on the device. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

name: set_alarm
description: This tool is used for setting a new alarm based on the user's specified time, label, recurrence pattern, sound preference, and specific day(s) for the alarm to activate.

required_parameters.name: time
required_parameters.description: The specified time for the alarm to go off.

optional_parameters.name: label
optional_parameters.description: A custom name or description for the alarm.

optional_parameters.name: recurrence
optional_parameters.description: Specifies how often the alarm should repeat. Each element in the list can be a keyword ('everyday', 'weekdays', 'weekends'), a name of the day ('Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'), or a specific date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

optional_parameters.name: sound
optional_parameters.description: The chosen sound for the alarm when it goes off.

optional_parameters.name: vibrate
optional_parameters.description: Specifies the intensity of the vibration for the alarm. A value of 0 means no vibration. If the intensity of the vibration is not specified, the default intensity is 5.

name: get_alarm
description: This tool is used to retrieve details about the user's existing alarms, including time, label, recurrence, and other settings.

optional_parameters.name: time
optional_parameters.description: The specific time of the alarm to retrieve information about.

optional_parameters.name: label
optional_parameters.description: The custom label or description associated with the alarm to identify it.

optional_parameters.name: recurrence
optional_parameters.description: Specifies how often the alarm should repeat. Each element in the list can be a keyword ('everyday', 'weekdays', 'weekends'), a name of the day ('Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'), or a specific date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

result_parameters.name: alarm_details
result_parameters.description: The details of the retrieved alarms, which could include time, label, recurrence, sound, vibration settings, etc.

result_parameters.name: time
result_parameters.description: The specific time of the alarm to retrieve information about.

result_parameters.name: label
result_parameters.description: The custom label or description associated with the alarm to identify it.

result_parameters.name: sound
result_parameters.description: The chosen sound for the alarm when it goes off.

result_parameters.name: vibrate
result_parameters.description: Specifies the intensity of the vibration for the alarm. A value of 0 means no vibration. If the intensity of the vibration is not specified, the default intensity is 5.

name: cancel_all_alarms
description: This tool is used to cancel all of the user's set alarms without requiring specific details for each individual alarm.

name: cancel_alarm
description: This tool is used to cancel one or more alarms based on the specified time and recurrence pattern.

optional_parameters.name: recurrence
optional_parameters.description: Specifies on which days the alarm should be canceled. Each element in the list can be a name of the day ('Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'), or a specific date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. If not provided, all alarms at the specified time will be canceled.

optional_parameters.name: time
optional_parameters.description: The specified time of the alarms to be canceled, in 24-hour format (HH:MM).

optional_parameters.name: label
optional_parameters.description: A custom name or description for the alarm.

name: change_alarm_name
description: This tool is used to change the name of an existing alarm to a new specified name.

optional_parameters.name: time
optional_parameters.description: The specific time of the alarm to retrieve information about.

optional_parameters.name: current_name
optional_parameters.description: The current name or label of the alarm that the user wants to change.

optional_parameters.name: new_name
optional_parameters.description: The new name or label that the user wants to assign to the alarm.

optional_parameters.name: recurrence
optional_parameters.description: Specifies how often the alarm should repeat. Each element in the list can be a keyword ('everyday', 'weekdays', 'weekends'), a name of the day ('Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'), or a specific date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

name: change_alarm_time
description: This tool is used to change the time of an existing alarm to a new specified time.

optional_parameters.name: label
optional_parameters.description: A custom name or description for the alarm.

optional_parameters.name: current_time
optional_parameters.description: The current time to which the user wants to change.

optional_parameters.name: new_time
optional_parameters.description: The new time to which the user wants to set the alarm.

optional_parameters.name: current_recurrence
optional_parameters.description: Specifies how often the alarm should repeat. Each element in the list can be a keyword ('everyday', 'weekdays', 'weekends'), a name of the day ('Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'), or a specific date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

optional_parameters.name: new_recurrence
optional_parameters.description: Specifies how often the copied alarm should repeat. Each element in the list can be a keyword ('everyday', 'weekdays', 'weekends'), a name of the day ('Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'), or a specific date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

name: change_alarm_sound
description: This tool is used to change the sound of an existing alarm to a new specified sound.

optional_parameters.name: label
optional_parameters.description: A custom name or description for the alarm.

optional_parameters.name: time
optional_parameters.description: The specified time for the alarm to go off.

optional_parameters.name: sound
optional_parameters.description: The new sound the user wants to use.

optional_parameters.name: vibrate
optional_parameters.description: Specifies the intensity of the vibration for the alarm. A value of 0 means no vibration. If the intensity of the vibration is not specified, the default intensity is 5.

optional_parameters.name: recurrence
optional_parameters.description: Specifies how often the alarm should repeat. Each element in the list can be a keyword ('everyday', 'weekdays', 'weekends'), a name of the day ('Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'), or a specific date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

name: copy_alarm
description: This tool is used to create a copy of an existing alarm with a new specified recurrence pattern and label, while preserving the original source time and recurrence.

required_parameters.name: source_time
required_parameters.description: The time of the existing alarm to copy, in the 24-hour format (HH:MM).

required_parameters.name: source_recurrence
required_parameters.description: The recurrence pattern of the existing alarm to copy. Each element can be a keyword ('everyday', 'weekdays', 'weekends'), a name of the day ('Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'), or a specific date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

required_parameters.name: target_recurrence
required_parameters.description: The new recurrence pattern assigned to the copied alarm. Each element can be a keyword ('everyday', 'weekdays', 'weekends'), a name of the day ('Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'), or a specific date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

optional_parameters.name: label
optional_parameters.description: A label for the copied alarm.

optional_parameters.name: target_time
optional_parameters.description: The time of the copied alarm, in the 24-hour format (HH:MM).
